verdict.rationale: Restate documents and runtime probes confirm an official hosted MCP server at docs.restate.dev/mcp that completed a full keyless JSON-RPC initialize handshake (protocolVersion 2025-06-18, serverInfo Restate), and docs describe a 'Restate plugin' teaching coding agents Restate's APIs and patterns. This is a genuine first-party MCP server a buyer could connect an agent to. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of real-world MCP usage, and evidence the MCP server exposes full runtime operations beyond docs/assistant guidance.
